Produces objectives, platform strategy, influencer tier mix, content requirements, timeline, budget allocation, KPI targets, and handoff steps. Not for individual creator briefs; use brief-generator for that task.

content.user_title: Plan Influencer Campaigns End to End
content.value_statement: Influencer campaigns fail when goals, creator mix, budget, and measurement are planned separately. This skill turns campaign inputs into a complete strategy blueprint for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
actual_capabilities: Collects brand, product, audience, budget, timeline, and constraint inputs before planning.
Defines SMART campaign objectives with success and failure thresholds.
Builds platform strategy, key messages, creator tier mix, and selection criteria.
Plans content deliverables, approval steps, phased timeline, and budget allocation.
Sets KPI targets, reporting cadence, and next-skill handoff recommendations.
limitations: Does not discover real creators without user data or an enabled influencer database connector.
Does not create individual creator briefs; it hands off to brief-generator.
Budget and KPI targets depend on provided benchmarks or assumptions.
Does not execute outreach, contracts, payments, or platform publishing.

use_cases.title: Launch Planning
use_cases.description: Build a product launch plan with creator tiers, content formats, dates, budget, and KPI targets.

use_cases.title: Agency Proposal Prep
use_cases.description: Turn client inputs into a structured campaign blueprint for review, approval, and brief creation.

use_cases.title: Always-On Program Design
use_cases.description: Design recurring creator activity with platform roles, reporting cadence, and budget guardrails.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Campaign Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with core campaign inputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an influencer campaign for [brand] promoting [product] to [audience] with a budget of [budget] during [timeframe].

prompt_templates.title: Launch Blueprint With Constraints
prompt_templates.scenario: Structured launch plan for stakeholder review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a campaign blueprint for [product launch]. Include objectives, creator tiers, platform split, content deliverables, approval steps, budget, KPIs, and risks. Constraints: [constraints].

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Draft Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this draft influencer plan and rebuild it with clearer SMART goals, tier mix, timeline, budget allocation, and measurement assumptions: [paste plan].

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Multi-Platform Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning with audience and benchmark data.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full campaign plan for [brand] across [platforms]. Use [audience insights], [past benchmark data], and [business goal] to define strategy, budget, deliverables, KPI targets, reporting cadence, and next-skill handoff.

output_examples.input: New sustainable sneaker launch for Gen Z on TikTok and Instagram with a $50K budget.
output_examples.output: A campaign plan with awareness and conversion objectives, TikTok and Instagram roles, micro-heavy creator mix, UGC deliverables, launch timeline, budget split, and promo-code tracking.

output_examples.input: Always-on beauty creator program for monthly product education and social proof.
output_examples.output: A recurring plan with monthly themes, nano and micro creator tiers, approval workflows, content volume targets, engagement benchmarks, and reporting cadence.

output_examples.input: B2B SaaS thought leadership campaign for LinkedIn creators before a webinar launch.
output_examples.output: A plan centered on expert creators, credibility messages, gated-event conversion goals, LinkedIn deliverables, approval checkpoints, and pipeline reporting.

best_practices: Provide budget, audience, timeframe, must-have platforms, and approval constraints before asking for the plan.
Replace every placeholder with a number, owner, date, or documented assumption.
Use past performance or connector data to calibrate reach, engagement, and conversion targets.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a creator shortlist before defining the campaign objective and selection criteria.
Do not leave content deliverables, KPI targets, or budget percentages as placeholders.
Do not use follower count alone as the creator selection rule.

faq.question: Can this skill find influencers?
faq.answer: It defines selection criteria and tier mix. Use influencer-discovery or a connector to build a real shortlist.

faq.question: Does it create creator briefs?
faq.answer: No. It prepares the campaign plan and recommends brief-generator for individual creator briefs.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Brand, product, audience, budget, timeframe, campaign type, target platforms, constraints, and known benchmarks work best.

faq.question: Can it work without external tools?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is Tier 1 and can produce a plan from user-provided inputs.

faq.question: How does it handle budget planning?
faq.answer: It allocates budget by category, creator tier, platform, and efficiency target when enough inputs are available.

faq.question: Is it useful for always-on programs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure recurring creator programs with themes, cadence, reporting, and budget guardrails.
